lineas.texto: Part two. Your new town has no stone walls. Stone is too expensive.
So everyone digs. A deep ditch all around, and the dirt piled up into a high bank.
The ditch fills with water: a moat. The bank gets a fence of sharp wooden stakes.
Your town runs on German town law. The same rules as hundreds of towns around you.
Market day comes every week. Salt, cloth, pots and fish come in through the gate.
The smith is the busiest man in town. Nails, hinges, plough blades.
At night, the gate closes, and the moat keeps the dark outside.
Part three, {when_next}: the day your town disappears.
